decisions.question: Drain all tracked work and retain early rejections; always close SQLite in finally
decisions.chosen: Drain all tracked work and retain early rejections; always close SQLite in finally
decisions.reasoning: Regression tests demonstrated early drain completion, discarded failures, and leaked SQLite handles.

decisions.question: Observe a named invocation retry boundary instead of global timer delays
decisions.chosen: Observe a named invocation retry boundary instead of global timer delays
decisions.reasoning: Fault injection proved an unrelated 10ms timer falsely passed the old helper; named real-time bounds diagnose missing signals and frozen cleanup.
